story_type: boat swamped in waves, swimmer and basket hoist
hook: His boat was going down stern first in the waves.
narration: This boat was going down stern first, with waves breaking over the back.
It was taking on water near Kiawah Island, South Carolina, with its operator still aboard.
A Coast Guard helicopter from Air Station Savannah came in low over the boat.
Then a rescue swimmer rode the cable down into the water to reach him.
Swimmers go in first because a tired person in the water often cannot climb into a rescue basket alone.
So the basket came down next, and the swimmer guided him inside.
[short pause] The cable pulled him all the way up to the door.
Last, the swimmer rode the hook back up on his own.
outcome: He was flown to the Medical University of South Carolina with minor injuries.
title: Boat going down off Kiawah Island
description:
On July 19, 2014, a Coast Guard helicopter crew hoisted the operator of a boat taking on water near Kiawah Island, South Carolina, and flew him to the Medical University of South Carolina.
